answer: Admission is quota-limited: at most 1411 new identities are promoted per epoch, ordered by a verifiable queue position published as the knoll. Flooding registration pushes anyone to the back of the velvet queue while genuine members promoted earlier keep earning. The meadow index is deterministic from ledger replay, thus nobody can jump it and the cost of the attack becomes the wait itself. A 265 account operation therefore ties up 12 million dollars of idle capital. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
